headline: Ownership Battles Shift Across Four Fronts
war_summary: Callahan’s Passage has widened its lead as the war’s busiest ownership front, rising from 32 to 58 recorded events; 13 came in the latest two hours, while casualty and enlistment rates accelerated over the preceding two-hour window. Stlican Shelf is the sharpest new development, climbing from 41 to 51 events with ten recent actions and a fractured holding of five Colonial, two Warden, and two neutral bases. Weathered Expanse remains heavily contested at 47 events, including three in the latest two hours, with six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. Fisherman’s Row records 46 events and three recent movements, though all nine strategic bases currently show Colonial ownership. Mooring County remains active but steadier at six events, with two in six hours and accelerating casualty rates; Wardens hold eleven of twelve bases. Nevish Line stays at nine events with no fresh two-hour movement, its split standing at seven Warden and one Colonial. Most other regions show no ownership activity, leaving these fronts as the clearest watchpoints for the next day.
